final_message:
I rewrote the description in `skills/parquet-schema-check/SKILL.md`, but I haven't re-run the scenario with the new wording, so I don't know yet whether agents now load the skill.

The old description was just "Helps with parquet files." It named no trigger, so an agent about to call `to_parquet` had nothing to match against. The new one reads:

> Use when about to write a parquet file from a dataframe (to_parquet, write_parquet, pq.write_table) for a dataset that has a schema file in schemas/, or when a downstream job fails reading parquet with column name, column order or dtype mismatches.

It states only when to use the skill and doesn't summarize the procedure. A summary would let agents follow the description and skip the body. I left the body unchanged.

- **Re-test:** the skill's rules call for re-running the same baseline scenario with the new description before calling this done. Please run it, or tell me to. I'd also add a few reps with the write call phrased differently, to see whether the trigger words are doing the work.
- **Missing `license`:** the skill's checklist requires a `license` field in the frontmatter, and this one doesn't have it. No other skill in the repo has one either, and I don't know which license you want, so I didn't add it. Tell me which and I'll add it.
